tables.name: users
tables.description: One row per user. MVP only ever authenticates the hardcoded 'user'/'password' (see backend auth), but the table is shaped to support real multi-user auth later without a schema change.

columns.name: password_hash
columns.description: Not used for the MVP login check (that's hardcoded). Present so a real password can be set later without altering the table.

tables.name: boards
tables.description: One row per board. unique(user_id) enforces the MVP's 'one board per user' limit; dropping that constraint later is enough to allow multiple boards per user.

tables.name: board_columns
tables.description: A Kanban column (e.g. 'Backlog'). Named board_columns, not columns, to avoid confusion with the SQL/schema term 'column'.

columns.name: position
columns.description: 0-based order among this board's columns. Left-to-right render order.

indexes.description: One column can't occupy two positions on the same board.

columns.name: position
columns.description: 0-based order within this column. Top-to-bottom render order.

indexes.description: One card can't occupy two positions in the same column.
